visible_text: 決まったことを待っています...
やることを待っています...
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く

answers.q1: A meeting recording/transcription tool has just started capturing a meeting called '14:50の会議'. It's 2 seconds into recording, actively listening, but nothing has been said yet, so the transcript, decisions, and to-dos are all empty placeholders.
answers.q2: That it is currently recording ('録音中 00:02') and listening ('聞いています...'), plus the meeting name '14:50の会議' — this tells the user the session is live and correctly capturing audio.
answers.q3: Start talking so the transcript fills in; use the floating pill controls at top to pause, add a comment, expand, or stop the recording; type a question in the bottom input box ('この会議について聞く'); or check summary/Q&A/decisions/action buttons once there is content.
answers.q4: Partially. The red recording dot, timer ticking up, and 'listening' waveform icon suggest it's active, but with an empty transcript and no live audio/waveform activity shown, there's no strong visual proof it's actually hearing anything yet — it could just as easily be stalled.
answers.q5: The four bottom action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are all grayed out/disabled with no content yet, so they just occupy space without doing anything at this moment. The three tabs (文字起こし/翻訳/字幕) also feel premature before any text exists.
answers.q6: The floating black pill control bar at the very top center, then down to the red '録音中' dot/timer just below it.

weaknesses.what: There is no visible live waveform or audio-level indicator tied to the microphone, so a first-time user watching an empty transcript at 00:02 cannot easily tell whether audio is truly being captured or the app is frozen.
weaknesses.fix: Add a small live audio-level meter or pulsing waveform next to '聞いています...' that visibly reacts to sound, giving instant proof of capture.

weaknesses.what: Four secondary action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are shown disabled with no data behind them yet, adding visual clutter before they're usable.
weaknesses.fix: Hide or collapse these buttons until the transcript has enough content to act on, or show them in a more minimal/ghost state until then.

weaknesses.what: The floating top control pill (pause/comment/expand/more/stop) is disconnected from the main card below it, making it unclear if it belongs to this meeting window or is a separate system-level overlay.
weaknesses.fix: Visually connect the pill to the card (e.g., a subtle shadow/line linking them, or docking it to the card's top edge) so it reads as one surface.
